newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy confirms EU meeting on lira ERM re-entry.
newsitem.headline: Italy confirms EU meeting on lira ERM re-entry.

text.p: Italy confirmed on Friday that the European Union's monetary committee would meet at 1200 GMT on Saturday to discuss a formal Italian request to return the lira to Europe's exchange rate mechanism (ERM).
"The Italian government has asked to begin the procedures for the return of the lira to the exchange rate accords envisaged by the European Monetary System," a Treasury Ministry statement said.
"The procedure will begin tomorrow with the meeting of the monetary committee scheduled for one p.m." (1200 GMT), the statement said.
The lira was forced out of the ERM in September 1992 by massive financial market pressure during a currency crisis.
Italy's centre-left government is keen to bring the currency back into the fold in order to improve its chances of qualifying for the single European currency in January 1999.
